collections.name: Featured
collections.description: The prints and gear behind this season’s stories.

products.title: Atacama at Dawn — fine-art print
products.description: The cover frame, printed the way we would hang it: a museum-grade archival pigment print on cotton rag, the desert mountains going from blue to gold in the first minute of light. Signed and numbered, shipped flat.
products.seoTitle: Atacama at Dawn — signed fine-art print | Wayfarer
products.seoDescription: A signed, numbered archival pigment print of the Atacama at first light, on cotton rag.

images.alt: A fine-art print of a mountain lake at dawn

products.title: The Last Glacier — fine-art print
products.description: From the Rockies photo story: a green glacial valley under a thinning field of ice. An archival pigment print on cotton rag, signed and numbered — a record of a place that will not look this way for long.
products.seoTitle: The Last Glacier — signed fine-art print | Wayfarer
products.seoDescription: A signed, numbered archival print of a glacial valley in the Rockies, on cotton rag.

images.alt: A fine-art print of a green glacial valley

products.title: Wayfarer Field Bag
products.description: The bag we actually carry: a weatherproof waxed-canvas camera bag that holds a body, three lenses, a flask and a notebook, and takes a tripod on the side. Built with a maker in the mountains it is named for.
products.seoTitle: Wayfarer Field Bag — weatherproof camera bag
products.seoDescription: A weatherproof waxed-canvas camera field bag: a body, three lenses, and a tripod on the side.

products.title: Latitudes — a photobook
products.description: Five years of the journal, edited down to one hundred and twenty photographs and the short essays that go with them. A heavyweight linen-bound book, printed and sewn to last longer than the trips it remembers.
products.seoDescription: A linen-bound photobook: one hundred and twenty photographs from five years of the journal.

images.alt: A hardback photobook on a table
